maria-cs: Hey devon, customer hit a 422 on /v1/rerank. They say scores are all zero and our client shows both `documents` and `candidates` fields in the payload. Sharing payload they used below.

maria-cs: ```json
{
  "query": { "text": "what is refund policy" },
  "documents": [ { "id": "d1", "text": "..." } ],
  "candidates": [ { "id": "c1", "passages": [{"text":"..."}] } ]
}
```

maria-cs: They say earlier SDK versions accepted this shape. Now request returns 422 and the rerank result has scores 0.0 for everything when it returns 200.

devon-se: Thanks, can you paste the exact response body for both the 422 and the 200 case? Also which API key / plan are they on?

maria-cs: 422 body: `{"error":"invalid input: ambiguous field 'query' found in nested doc and root"}`. 200 case (when they removed `documents`): `{"results":[{"id":"c1","score":0.0}]}`

jin-eng: looks like a name collision: `query` exists in root and also inside candidate/docs? but your payload shows `query` only at root. Do they have `query` inside one of the docs in metadata?

maria-cs: Good catch — their internal indexing pipeline had `metadata.query` on docs. They said it was harmless before.

ops-bob: Another angle: we changed parser precedence last month to prefer nested `query` over root to support embedded searches. That could explain the 422 on ambiguous shapes.

devon-se: If parser prefers nested, then the server tries to bind `query` to candidate.passages or doc.metadata and chokes when both exist. Can we get repro steps?

maria-cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/rerank with payload above 2) server returns 422 3) remove `documents` field or rename inner `query` to `q` => 200 but scores 0.0 4) set `query` only inside `candidates[].passages[]` and remove root => works with nonzero scores

jin-eng: useful. Can you attach the minimal curl they used?

maria-cs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":{"text":"refund"},"documents":[{"id":"d1","metadata":{"query":"legacy"},"text":"return policy..."}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","passages":[{"text":"refund policy details"}]}]}'
```

jin-eng: OK I can repro locally. Looks like two problems: (1) ambiguous binding causes validation error when same logical key exists in multiple object scopes, (2) when we fall back to root query we accidentally pass dtype=string->embedding vector codepath that yields zero scores for rerank. I'll open a ticket.

devon-se: Can we offer a short-term workaround to the customer?

jin-eng: Quick fixes: a) ask them to rename their doc metadata field from `query` to `src_query` b) move their root `query` inside `candidates[0].passages[0]` if they want to keep legacy doc fields c) use `?strict_schema=true` to force error earlier (helps detect ambiguous fields).

maria-cs: I'll pass options. Also customer asked if this is a breaking change from previous SDK.

jin-eng: It is a change — we tightened validation and changed precedence last month. We'll include migration notes. For now I'll tag the ticket P1 because it causes silent zero scores in some paths.

api-bot: New ticket created: RW-INF-1298 — "rerank: ambiguous query binding causes 422 or zero scores". Assigned to jin-eng.

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer with the rename and `?strict_schema=true` workaround and link RW-INF-1298.
